title: AudiPsy: Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning over Spoken Counseling Conversations for Depression Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2610.27567v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Depression assessment from counseling speech requires integrating textual and acoustic psychological evidence across turns, yet existing end-to-end classification approaches lack explicit multimodal evidence interpretation and context-aware reasoning. We propose AudiPsy, an evidence-grounded omni-LLM for depression assessment over spoken counseling conversations. AudiPsy employs an Observation-Assessment-Summary (OAS) paradigm to integrate dialogue transcripts, textual and acoustic emotions, and textual-acoustic emotion incongruence into structured reasoning. OAS incrementally organizes multimodal observations, performs contextualized assessment, and maintains an evolving dialogue summary for subsequent turns. To support this framework, we construct AudiPsy-Counsel, a synthetic spoken counseling conversation corpus with multimodal context augmentation, and develop a unified three-stage curriculum for depression-oriented reasoning. translated_title: AudiPsy：基于证据的多模态推理方法，用于口语心理咨询对话中的抑郁症评估
translated_abstract: 从心理咨询语音中进行抑郁症评估需要跨轮次整合文本与声学两方面的心理学证据，然而现有的端到端分类方法缺乏显式的多模态证据解释和情境感知推理能力。我们提出了AudiPsy，一个基于证据的全模态大语言模型，用于口语心理咨询对话中的抑郁症评估。AudiPsy采用观察-评估-总结（Observation-Assessment-Summary, OAS）范式，将对话转录文本、文本情绪与声学情绪以及文本-声学情绪不一致性整合到结构化推理中，逐步组织多模态观察结果、进行情境化评估，并为后续对话轮次维护一个持续更新的对话总结。为支持该框架，我们构建了AudiPsy-Counsel——一个具有多模态上下文增强的合成口语心理咨询对话语料库，并开发了一套面向抑郁症推理的统一三阶段课程训练方法。实验...
tldr: 提出AudiPsy，一个基于证据的全模态大语言模型，通过观察-评估-总结范式对口语心理咨询对话中的文本与声学多模态证据进行结构化情境推理，显著提升了抑郁症评估的可解释性与准确性。
en_tdlr: AudiPsy is an evidence-grounded omni-LLM that performs structured multimodal reasoning over spoken counseling conversations using an Observation-Assessment-Summary paradigm, enabling interpretable and context-aware depression assessment.
